prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-photorealistic cozy winter window portrait with a snowy mountain landscape, preserving the cream knit outfit, earmuffs, boots and warm wood interior.
prompt.main_subject: One original approved adult woman with long straight-to-wavy blonde hair, natural fair skin and a soft direct smile. She wears a creamy ribbed knit long-sleeve top, black thigh-high socks with two white stripes, tan shearling-lined winter hiking boots with bright red laces, fluffy black earmuffs, a black lace choker and a thin gold key pendant.
prompt.composition_elements: Eye-level portrait seated on a light-wood window ledge, angled slightly forward with one knee bent and hands resting on the sill. Include a large glass pane, light wood frame, snow-covered ground, white-barked trees, distant snowy mountains and bright overcast sky outside.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused natural daylight through the window creates gentle highlights on hair, ribbed knit and boots with minimal interior shadows. Keep the atmosphere cozy, bright, playful and winter-resort inspired without sexualized framing.
prompt.technical_specs: 50–85mm portrait lens feel at f/2.8, sharp subject and knit/boot texture, shallow background depth, realistic snow detail, balanced cool outdoor and warm wood tones, high-resolution natural color.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-photorealistic cozy winter window portrait of one original approved adult woman with long blonde hair, natural fair skin and a soft direct smile. She wears a creamy ribbed knit long-sleeve top, black thigh-high socks with two white stripes, tan shearling-lined winter hiking boots with bright red laces, fluffy black earmuffs, a black lace choker and a thin gold key pendant. Seat her on a light-wood window ledge angled slightly forward with one knee bent and hands resting on the sill. Include a large glass pane, light wood frame, snow-covered ground, white-barked trees, distant snowy mountains and bright overcast sky outside. Use soft diffused daylight, gentle highlights, minimal shadows, realistic knit, hair, boots and snow texture, a 50–85mm f/2.8 portrait look and balanced cool-warm color.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, fetish framing, child, teen, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted anatomy, wardrobe malfunction, missing boots, missing earmuffs, invented logos, unreadable text
